source.mode: read-only audit (Plan agents), no code changes
source.localOriginals: artifacts/engine-refactor-audit-20261010/ (ignored; findings.json holds full evidence, proposals and verifier votes)

approval: 2026-10-10: the user approved every decision below with its recommended option and asked to execute all waves through workflows.
verification: Medium+ bug/security findings were checked by an adversarial verifier, high/critical by a second; low bug/security and all structure findings are single-finder claims (unverified-low / unverified-structure). Each execution unit re-checks its findings against the current code before changing it.

decisions.topic: D-CRED: host-declared credential variable names stripped from child environments (public API addition)
decisions.options: (a) Optional EngineOptions.credentialEnvNames, registered process-wide (add-only) and stripped by createCommandEnvironment for every child incl. git; the harness passes providers[*].apiKeyEnv and agent-backend env names. (b) A createCommandEnvironment parameter threaded through ~20 spawn sites. (c) Document that hosts must not keep credentials in process.env.
decisions.approved: (a): additive and optional, matches the process-wide nature of env, default denylist unchanged. Planned as WP-X-0-02.

decisions.topic: D-HOSTCMD: host-command approval journal stores workspace file contents (persisted format)
decisions.options: (a) New records persist a content-free manifest {path, sha256, bytes} in revisions and events; validators accept old content rows. (b) Keep contents in host_command_revisions, hashes only in session events, with dual-shape readRow and archive import. (c) Keep as is and document.
decisions.approved: (a): validation is hash-only (host-command-records.ts:503), so old and new rows validate with no schema change and ignored secrets leave both stores. Planned as WP-X-0-03.

decisions.topic: D-TOOLPOLICY: ToolPolicy path rules are lexical (approval semantics)
decisions.options: (a) Document lexical matching only. (b) (a) plus list/search traversal skips descendants matching deny/ask path rules. (c) Canonical resource identities and allow-requires-full-cover, which changes grant scope identity and persisted grant documents.
decisions.approved: (b) as WP-X-0-04; consider (c) only together with a grant-format migration plan.

decisions.topic: D-CLEARTEXT: plain-http endpoints carrying API keys (config and adapter behaviour)
decisions.options: (a) https or loopback only for every adapter and config. (b) (a), but non-loopback http stays allowed when no apiKey is configured. (c) Keep per-adapter differences.
decisions.approved: (b) as WP-X-0-07: keys never travel in cleartext and keyless LAN servers keep working.

decisions.topic: D-GIT-OBSERVE: repository filters during engine read-only git observation
decisions.options: (a) Keep filters active for status, diff --name-only and ls-files; only the environment is hardened (WP-X-0-01). (b) Apply safe-checkout's filter and hook overrides to observation commands too.
decisions.approved: (a): disabling clean filters makes LFS and filtered files look modified; the PR host's own check is hardened separately in WP-C5-0-02.

decisions.topic: D-PARTICIPANT: replacing per-feature CoordinatorOptions hooks (type exported via ports.ts)
decisions.options: (a) Add RunParticipant and keep the old hook fields as deprecated adapters. (b) Replace the hooks outright, breaking the public type. (c) Keep per-feature hooks.
decisions.approved: (a) in WP-X-4-03; remove the adapters with the D-PUBLIC batch.

decisions.topic: D-CODES: error codes when shared helpers replace per-module copies (consolidates C2, C3 foreign codes, C4 D-CONSISTENCY-CODES, C5 D3)
decisions.options: (a) Helpers take codes as parameters: each site keeps its own code; foreign-domain codes (KNOWLEDGE_*, JOB_* raised by another module) and raw errors (RangeError, SQLite, plain Error) become that module's existing code; no new codes; list changes in release notes. (b) Pure refactor that also keeps foreign codes. (c) Collapse to generic codes.
decisions.approved: (a): it matches the C2, C3 and C5 choices and C4's keep-own-codes rule; the only C4 change is P13-S23 (INVALID_KNOWLEDGE to INVALID_PROPOSAL_APPLY).

decisions.topic: D-BYTES: byte-identical persisted formats behind shared engines (journal, delivery, hashes, blob store)
decisions.options: (a) Proceed only behind byte-level gates: golden digests and archive export/import round-trips captured before each refactor; the only intended output change is new truncated child outcomes (P11-S28). (b) Do primitives only; defer the journal engine (X2-01) and delivery factory (X2-02). (c) Skip shared components.
decisions.approved: (a), with X2-01 last in wave 3; fall back to (b) for X2-01 if the agent-backends round-trip cannot be made byte-identical.

decisions.topic: D-PUBLIC: unused public engine API (consolidates C1, C2, C3 deprecate vs C4, C5 remove)
decisions.options: (a) @moodcode/engine is private: remove every unused export that apps/desktop, apps/engine-harness and scripts do not import, in one batch. (b) Mark @deprecated now, remove at the next API revision. (c) Keep the per-cluster split (C4/C5 remove, C1-C3 deprecate).
decisions.approved: (a) with a grep gate over apps/ and scripts/ in each package; it fits the short-code goal and the package has no external consumers.

decisions.topic: D-RETENTION: append-only journals and bounded evidence stores without reclamation
decisions.options: (a) Now: recovery headroom and reclaim where the record format allows (planned wave-1 packages); later: one retention design inside the shared journal profile (X2-01) with a format review. (b) Raise caps. (c) Per-store retention now.
decisions.approved: (a). P04-B05 has no package: add a small coding-runs follow-up that evicts settled run() idempotency entries like WP-C3-1-15 does for WorkflowService.

decisions.topic: D-UNCERTAIN: when an outcome may be recorded as uncertain (cancel / unknown-outcome semantics)
decisions.options: (a) 'uncertain' only when an effect may have started: never-started or confirmed-cleaned paths settle as cancelled or failed, while a committed marker without the lock stays uncertain (P16-B03). (b) Keep today's conservative classification.
decisions.approved: (a) as planned by the clusters. P03-B06 (no durable group PID in the execution-lock marker) has no package: reproduce a real crash first, then fix the writer in tools/command/execution-lock.ts without a schema change.

decisions.topic: D-ORDER: timing of the structural moves (facade split, child host, storage/recovery files)
decisions.options: (a) EngineRuntime types in wave 3; facade split, child-host extraction and storage/recovery file moves at the end of wave 4. (b) Split engine.ts first so module packages target collaborators. (c) Skip the X1-10 file moves (path churn for a type-level cycle).
decisions.approved: (a): cluster packages keep valid file paths and compress code before it moves.

decisions.topic: D-CLUSTER: cluster-local decisions retained as recommended
decisions.options: (a) Accept the cluster recommendations unchanged. (b) Revisit them individually.
decisions.approved: (a): none conflicts with the global plan. D-FORMATTER stays (b): a repo-wide formatter run as a separate change after this refactor.

decisions.topic: Agent profile model key allowlist (public API tightening)
decisions.options: (a) register() rejects any model key other than providerId/modelId/reasoningEffort with INVALID_AGENT_PROFILE. (b) apply() silently ignores undeclared keys. (c) Keep the current behavior.
decisions.approved: (a). It matches the declared profile type, stops a profile from switching Plan to Build, and uses an existing code. Planned as WP-C1-0-01.

decisions.topic: Config layer merge for provider baseURL/apiKeyEnv (documented merge semantics)
decisions.options: (a) Provider metadata is one unit per layer: a workspace entry that changes baseURL does not inherit the user layer's apiKeyEnv. (b) The workspace layer may not set apiKeyEnv or override baseURL for providers the user layer defines (CONFIG_INVALID). (c) Keep the merge and rely on host workspace trust.
decisions.approved: (a), as WP-C1-0-02. (b) is stronger but blocks workspace-local proxies. An apiKeyEnv set explicitly in the workspace layer remains a host workspace-trust question.

decisions.topic: Keep or remove observePluginTool (public, no repo consumer)
decisions.options: (a) Remove it with ToolHookMetadata/PluginToolHooks (breaking public API). (b) Keep it and add a host-facing doc line.
decisions.approved: (b), folded into WP-C1-1-03. There is no evidence about external hosts that would justify a break.

decisions.topic: Pre-dispatch cancellation of approved client effects (cancel / unknown-outcome semantics)
decisions.options: (a) A never-dispatched effect settles as cancelled with cleanupConfirmed:true. (b) Keep reporting CLEANUP_UNCERTAIN and quarantining the workspace.
decisions.approved: (a). Nothing ran, and readProviderClientEffectScope already treats a cancel before the physical source this way. Planned in WP-C1-1-06.

decisions.topic: RunCoordinator/InputScheduler summary-recovery aliases (public classes)
decisions.options: (a) Delete withSummaryRecoveryLease and holdSummaryRecoveryWorkspace (public break). (b) Mark them @deprecated and switch internal callers to the targets. (c) Keep them as they are.
decisions.approved: (b) in WP-C1-2-02. Delete them at the next major API revision.

decisions.topic: recoverEngine reporting after the ledger commit (error codes / result shape)
decisions.options: (a) Rethrow RECOVERY_* unchanged from the ledger catch, and report post-commit marker blockers through effectMarkerCleared:false plus an optional additive field. (b) Add a new 'acknowledged, marker not cleared' error code. (c) Keep the current behavior.
decisions.approved: (a), as WP-C1-1-09: no new error code, and the audit-before-effect order is kept.

decisions.topic: Durable group PID for the execution-lock effect marker (persisted marker semantics, C2 file)
decisions.options: (a) Commit group_pid in a short separate transaction in tools/command/execution-lock.ts. (b) Record it in a side table, which needs a schema change beyond DB 23. (c) Keep the current behavior and document manual remediation.
decisions.approved: Not planned in C1. Prefer (a), owned by C2's execution-lock work after a real-crash reproduction. (b) is excluded because the schema stays at version 23.

decisions.topic: CodingBatchHost run() idempotency map eviction (no-replay)
decisions.options: (a) Keep the per-process 128-request bound and document it. (b) Count only unsettled operations and retain settled results (unbounded memory). (c) A bounded LRU replay cache, where eviction can re-execute a replayed request (no-replay risk).
decisions.approved: (a) for now. Decide jointly with the WorkflowService owners/stageRequests caps in C3. Not planned in C1.

decisions.topic: Coding batch maxEvidenceBytes accepted range (public API)
decisions.options: (a) Reject values above 262144 in validateBatch. (b) Raise the storage case-receipt read limit to the validated 1 MiB. (c) Keep the late failure after the review stage.
decisions.approved: (a), as WP-C1-1-12. (b) enlarges persisted rows and storage bounds.

decisions.topic: Coding batch approval error codes
decisions.options: (a) run() throws EngineError CODING_BATCH_APPROVAL_REQUIRED, and skip/cancel separate the approval check (APPROVAL_REQUIRED) from the revision check (STALE). (b) Fix run() only. (c) Keep the current behavior.
decisions.approved: (a) in WP-C1-1-11. run() currently rejects with a plain Error that has no code, and start, selection and resume already use APPROVAL_REQUIRED.

decisions.topic: Public-surface side effects of the compression packages
decisions.options: (a) Accept the additive exports (normalizeRunConfig, INPUT_MEDIA_LIMITS), strict boolean validation of gitCommits, and dispatchSession using dispatch's commandId echo rule. Skip the per-entry media details.path change and do not narrow ResponsesProviderOptions. (b) Also adopt per-entry media paths and narrow the options type. (c) Defer all of them.
decisions.approved: (a). The additions are additive or align with sibling behavior, while (b) changes error details and a public option type.

decisions.topic: Retention for bounded evidence stores that never reclaim slots (owned command jobs: 128, sandbox records: 256)
decisions.options: (a) Prune the oldest terminal, unreferenced records in the admitting transaction, keeping uncertain/paused-import and anything a delivery receipt or live handle references; archive and graph validation accept pruned chains. (b) Compact settled records into a bounded summary document (new persisted kind). (c) Scope caps per workspace/session and add a host-callable prune with explicit evidence retention.
decisions.approved: (a) for P07-B01 now, because desktop ships jobs: true and run_command stops after 128 calls. Schema 23 and the record format stay unchanged. Apply (a) to P05-B07 only after it is reproduced. Do not raise the caps.

decisions.topic: Code-mode run cancelled or closed with confirmed cleanup: persisted record state and cancel/unknown-outcome semantics
decisions.options: (a) Add an 'interrupted' record state. This is an additive persisted-format change that older engines and archives reject. (b) Settle as the existing 'failed' state with errorCode CANCELLED and let validateNative accept tool.state 'interrupted' for it. (c) Keep 'uncertain' and add an explicit, acknowledged recovery API.
decisions.approved: (b): the persisted state enum stays unchanged and the workspace is unblocked. A later, separate decision covers (c) for runs that really are uncertain.

decisions.topic: Approval semantics: role deny-all/ask-all rules over unknown resources
decisions.options: (a) The 'all' selector matches unknown resources for deny and ask rules (fail closed). (b) Keep today's behavior, where deny-all becomes an approvable ask, and document it.
decisions.approved: (a). It is a security tightening with no format change. Hosts that see new denials can add explicit ask rules.

decisions.topic: Cancel semantics: the caller's signal on a background command lifetime start
decisions.options: (a) Bind the signal only while startLifetime is pending, then unbind it for background mode. (b) Bind it only for foreground mode, which loses abort during background admission. (c) Keep it and document that the start signal stays attached.
decisions.approved: (a). Abort during admission still works, and background lifetimes match what transfer() produces.

decisions.topic: Error-code surface: existing codes replace raw or misleading errors
decisions.options: Accept: start() after the approved commit returns CLEANUP_UNCERTAIN; fs ENOENT/ENOTDIR/ELOOP become the *_STALE codes; a reused outputId becomes JOB_REVISION_CONFLICT; an empty output page becomes JOB_OUTPUT_STALE (or, for P06-B03, a durable no-op). Or reject the changes and keep the current errors.
decisions.approved: Accept all four using existing codes only, with no new codes. For P06-B03, reject rather than no-op, so host polling cannot fill the journal.

decisions.topic: Public result and backend interface shape
decisions.options: P05-B06: allow truncated=true with omittedReceipts=0, or add a new field. P21-B02: (a) carry the startup PtyOutcome on an internal channel; (b) add an optional outcome to EngineError or PtyBackend (contracts change).
decisions.approved: P05-B06: allow truncated=true with omittedReceipts=0, since the shape is unchanged. P21-B02: option (a), so no public shape changes.

decisions.topic: Unused public surface left after cleanup
decisions.options: The TerminalSourcePin type alias, and TerminalService.readReadObservation, which has no engine caller once P06-S05 removes the producer's readObservation: (a) remove both, a public-API break; (b) mark them @deprecated; (c) keep them.
decisions.approved: (c) for now. Revisit both in one public-API cleanup batch.

decisions.topic: The Seatbelt profile change invalidates MCP sandbox grants issued before the upgrade
decisions.options: (a) Accept that existing MCP grants fail SANDBOX_MCP_GRANT_STALE and are approved again. (b) Version the profile and keep the old text for old grants, which leaves the .git hole open for them.
decisions.approved: (a). It fails closed, the grant format is unchanged, and one re-approval per MCP grant is acceptable.

decisions.topic: Retention for the append-only agent-backend, workflow and schedule journals
decisions.options: (a) Keep the global caps and ship only internal recovery headroom (WP-C3-1-03, WP-C3-1-14, WP-C3-1-17). (b) Retention/compaction of terminal entities and superseded lease/observation revisions: changes revision chains, validate() rules and archive checks (persisted format). (c) Per-kind budgets or coalescing of per-frame and lease revisions.
decisions.approved: (a) now. Then decide (b)/(c) per store with a format review, starting with agent-backend per-frame observation rows and schedule lease renewals, ideally inside the shared journal engine (X2-01).

decisions.topic: Effect-batch 256-record lifetime cap
decisions.options: (a) Keep and document the bound. (b) Skip native batch records for single-member batches, which are serial already. (c) Retire terminal batch documents after run end and lock release. (d) Raise the cap. (b)-(d) change persisted evidence or the documented bound (docs/moodcode/engine-phase-two-effect-batches.md), and archive validation (storage/archive.ts:300) must agree.
decisions.approved: (b) plus documentation: removes most consumption without touching multi-member evidence or the archive validation rules.

decisions.topic: Error code for terminal-control capacity overflow
decisions.options: (a) Pre-send check raising the codes seen today (KNOWLEDGE_LIMIT or BACKEND_TERMINAL_STALE). (b) Pre-send check raising the existing BACKEND_LIMIT.
decisions.approved: (b): KNOWLEDGE_LIMIT is a foreign-domain code and BACKEND_LIMIT already means backend capacity; record the mapping change in release notes.

decisions.topic: Meaning of the 8-team per-workspace limit
decisions.options: (a) Concurrent limit: count active, unexpired teams (WP-C3-1-07). (b) Lifetime limit, documented in TEAM_LIMIT's message and docs.
decisions.approved: (a): teams expire within an hour, so a lifetime cap disables createTeam permanently after eight teams.

decisions.topic: Board document location for teams spanning root sessions
decisions.options: (a) Claimant's root session is canonical; validators follow; no new field (WP-C3-1-08). (b) Reject cross-root membership while board tools are bound, with a new error code. (c) Record a board session on the team at first submit (new persisted field).
decisions.approved: (a): smallest change, matches the completion hook at engine.ts:846, adds no field and no code.

decisions.topic: Workflow raw errors that will surface existing codes
decisions.options: (a) Deleted editor files fail with WORKFLOW_CHILD_EFFECT_FAILED (on the service fail list) and a reused create requestId with WORKFLOW_REQUEST_CONFLICT (WP-C3-1-13, WP-C3-1-14). (b) For deletions, support them end to end with an absent-file pin (effect record format change).
decisions.approved: (a) now; (b) only if editors that delete files become a product requirement.

decisions.topic: Validator stage sharing an editor's worktree
decisions.options: (a) Require join 'all' plus a dependency at registration only (WP-C3-1-16). (b) Also enforce on stored-spec validation, which rejects existing databases holding such specs. (c) Leave as is.
decisions.approved: (a): closes the race for new specs without breaking stored ones.

decisions.topic: Reclassifying wrong 'cleanup uncertain' outcomes for never-started processes and settled worktrees
decisions.options: (a) Report existing start-failed/busy codes (BACKEND_PROCESS_START_FAILED, MCP_START_FAILED, WORKTREE_BUSY or CHILD_WORKTREE_NOT_READY) and release locks as confirmed when no process or effect can exist. (b) Keep the uncertain codes and require manual repair.
decisions.approved: (a): uncertain should mean an effect may have happened. P11-B10 first needs proof that no effect starts for failed/removed records.

decisions.topic: Unused public types and aliases
decisions.options: (a) Remove McpTransport.dispatchBoundary, WorkflowScalar and the ScheduleTarget alias now. (b) Mark them @deprecated and remove at the next public API revision. (c) Keep them.
decisions.approved: (b): all three are reachable through export * / export type * from src/index.ts, so removal belongs in a planned API revision.

decisions.topic: Foreign error codes from borrowed JSON guards
decisions.options: (a) Map to the module's own codes (WORKFLOW_* in the workflow store json(), EFFECT_BATCH_EVIDENCE_INVALID in effect-batch validation) inside the X1-08 package. (b) Keep the KNOWLEDGE_*/JOB_* codes that surface today.
decisions.approved: (a): callers already handle the module codes and the foreign ones are accidental; list the mapping change in release notes.

decisions.topic: Single UTF-8 truncation for child outcomes
decisions.options: (a) One byte-boundary prefix helper (X3-11) in boundedOutcome and the delegation excerpt, accepting that new truncated outcomes can differ when U+FFFD sits at the cut. (b) Keep both algorithms.
decisions.approved: (a): stored outcomes are not re-derived, so only new records differ; note it as a persisted-output change.

decisions.topic: D-FILE-HEAD: file-publication native head identity
decisions.options: (a) Stable projection (no ancestor mtime/ctime) for head advancement: captureWorkspaceKnowledgeTarget/getWorkspaceKnowledgeFileTarget return fewer revisions; update docs/moodcode/engine-phase-two-file-publication.md:9. (b) Keep full-observation heads and add a revoke path that tolerates ancestor metadata drift.
decisions.approved: (a). Revisions are identifiers, not counts, and (b) still lets observation rows grow without bound.

decisions.topic: D-GEN-PREVIEW: generation recovery preview lifecycle
decisions.options: (a) One live recovery preview per workspace, replaced on issue and released on close; no API change. (b) Add public Engine.releaseWorkspaceKnowledgeRecoveryPreview mirroring the import preview. (c) Delete releaseRecoveryPreview, a public KnowledgeGenerationStorage method.
decisions.approved: (a). Add (b) later only if hosts need overlapping previews.

decisions.topic: D-GEN-BUDGET: generation request deadline vs cleanup window
decisions.options: (a) Clip the request window to deadline - cleanupTimeoutMs internally. (b) Also reject budgets where providerRequestTimeoutMs + cleanupTimeoutMs > maxDurationMs, which changes which budgets are accepted.
decisions.approved: (a) only. (b) changes budget semantics.

decisions.topic: D-PROPOSAL-NOREPLAY: zero-effect apply cancellations
decisions.options: (a) Keep no-replay: a cancellation that changed no file still consumes the revision; improve the error text and document the rule. (b) Record zero-attempt, fully observed, unchanged outcomes as non-terminal settlements (state machine and persisted-format change).
decisions.approved: (a). Revisit (b) only with a schema v24 plan.

decisions.topic: D-PROPOSAL-APPLY-CODES: busy guard lock code and win32 refusal
decisions.options: B07: keep PROPOSAL_APPLY_GUARD_INVALID for a busy lock, or throw the existing busy/cleanup-pending code. B05: refuse win32 at preview with an existing code, or widen guard path validation to platform paths (persisted guard row format).
decisions.approved: B07: use the existing busy code, which is accurate and retriable. B05: refuse at preview with an existing code; add no new code.

decisions.topic: D-CONSISTENCY-CODES: error codes when duplicated helpers merge
decisions.options: (a) Freeze codes: merged helpers take a fail callback so every site keeps today's code, and divergences are recorded. (b) Unify codes per module, which changes observable codes and proposal sourceFreshness output.
decisions.approved: (a) everywhere. Exception: accept STORE_CLOSED from the public SqliteStore.getAttemptUsage after close, since it currently surfaces a raw SQLite error.

decisions.topic: D-PUBLIC-DEAD: unused public knowledge API
decisions.options: (a) Remove KnowledgeFileLegacyTarget, KnowledgeStorageConstruction, KnowledgeGenerationStorage.listAttempts/listGenerations/page, and KnowledgeStorage assertCandidateCurrent/getImportPause/listCandidates/exportRows/markImportPaused. (b) Keep them as host API and only simplify the listGenerations cursor.
decisions.approved: (a) if no consumer outside packages/engine imports them. The P18-S19 removals ride with the X2-08 shared package.

decisions.topic: D-PUB-GETTER: KnowledgePublicationStorage.getPublication contract
decisions.options: (a) Narrow the public context-types port return types to KnowledgePublicationRecord and document the KNOWLEDGE_NOT_FOUND throw. (b) Return undefined like the sibling getters and move the throw to callers, which changes public class behavior.
decisions.approved: (a). P01 then removes the dead guards at engine.ts:2508/2511.

decisions.topic: D-PUBLIC-TYPES: storage public type declarations
decisions.options: S10: the public ModelHistoryPage becomes the native-history declaration (may gain optional sessionSegmentAnchor), or the facade copy stays authoritative. S01: type names stay the same; their export path in packages/engine/src/index.ts:92-93 moves to storage/input-index.ts.
decisions.approved: Accept both: the field is additive and optional, and the names are unchanged. Keep DOCUMENT_CONTEXT_LIMIT for media and add a one-line comment.

decisions.topic: D-FORMATTER: engine formatter config
decisions.options: (a) Adopt an engine Prettier config and reformat touched files mechanically. (b) No config; reflow by hand to the dominant style inside the packages that touch each file.
decisions.approved: (b) for this refactor. Do (a) as a separate repo-wide change so it does not collide with the structural packages.

decisions.topic: D1: Remove test-only or unused public engine API
decisions.options: (a) Remove now and record the breaking change. (b) Keep them and document them as supported host API. (c) Mark them @deprecated now and remove them in the next major version.
decisions.approved: (a) for P19-S04, S12, S20, S21, S22 and PR_LIMITS.textBytes: neither apps/desktop nor apps/engine-harness uses them. For P20-S12, (a) with explicit lists that keep every type hosts import; use (c) if external hosts exist.

decisions.topic: D2: Additive public exports and where new PR helpers live
decisions.options: (a) Add the missing type and limit exports so related modules match. (b) Freeze the public surface and record the gaps as intentional. For P20-S02: either export the new helpers from the wildcard types.ts, or keep them in a module that is not wildcard-exported.
decisions.approved: (a) for P19-S26 and P22-S25 (type-only and additive). For P20-S02, keep the helpers in a module that is not wildcard-exported, so internal policy helpers do not become API.

decisions.topic: D3: Error-code edge changes from shared validators and LSP limits
decisions.options: (a) Accept the documented edge changes: extra keys rejected, a different code for some malformed inputs, LSP_FRAME_LIMIT on a single request. (b) Give shared helpers the caller's error code as a parameter so every current code is kept.
decisions.approved: (b) for P19-S13, P19-S23, P22-S05 and P22-S06. (a) for P19-B04: it reuses the existing LSP_FRAME_LIMIT on one request instead of closing the whole connection.

decisions.topic: D4: Which GitHub reviewers can make a PR watch repair-eligible
decisions.options: (a) Count only OWNER, MEMBER and COLLABORATOR reviews toward changesRequested and quote the others as advisory. This needs author_association in the stored snapshot, which changes a persisted format. (b) Document that any reviewer can trigger repair.
decisions.approved: (b) now. Schedule (a) together with a persisted-format decision, because repair runs spend budget and put reviewer text into the agent prompt.

packages.title: Restrict agent profile model overrides to providerId, modelId and reasoningEffort
packages.contractImpact: Public API tightening (see decision): register() rejects undeclared model keys with the existing INVALID_AGENT_PROFILE code. Declared types are unchanged.
packages.change: P01-B01: in register(), reject any profile.model key other than providerId, modelId and reasoningEffort with INVALID_AGENT_PROFILE, and still validate those values. In apply(), merge only the three named fields instead of spreading profile.model. Add tests showing that a profile model carrying mode or limits is rejected.

packages.title: Keep workspace config from redirecting a user provider's baseURL with an inherited apiKeyEnv
packages.contractImpact: Changes the documented loadConfig merge semantics (public API). CONFIG_* codes are unchanged. Requires the config-merge decision.
packages.change: P01-B05, gated on the config-merge decision. Recommended option: treat provider metadata as one unit per layer, so a workspace entry that changes baseURL no longer inherits apiKeyEnv from the user layer. Update the merge test that asserts inheritance and add a redirect case. No other config validation changes.

packages.title: Strip providerReplay from semantic fork lineage quotes and child inheritance
packages.contractImpact: None. Only newly created semantic previews change content; stored previews keep their self-contained hashes.
packages.change: P03-B03: drop providerReplay from each parent transcript entry in two places: when building the semantic lineage message (fork-host.ts:445-461), and in source.messages inside inheritForkChild. This mirrors projectForkTranscript's semantic projection. Exact-replay forks keep their replay state. Add a test with a parent that carries providerReplay.

packages.title: Restart failed workspace change consumers and remove the :memory: temp artifact directory
packages.contractImpact: None. WorkspaceChangeHub gains an internal head-seq accessor; the public watch API is unchanged.
packages.change: P01-B02 per verifierCorrections: track the last processed seq. When the loop ends while the engine is open, drop the map entry so the next watchWorkspace restarts from that seq; if that seq has expired, fall back to a new head-seq accessor on WorkspaceChangeHub.
